_comment: Copy this to $YOKE_HOME/config/profile.json (default ~/.yoke/config/profile.json) and edit. 'prompt' is fed to the model verbatim as the scoring profile — describe your lane, differentiators, seniority, languages, geo, comp floor. Be specific; vague profiles score everything mediocre.
name: Jane Doe
headline: Senior Software Engineer
prompt: Jane Doe — 10y software engineering, 2y applied AI. Target lane: Applied AI Engineer / Backend / Platform at AI-infra or product companies. Differentiators (count how many the role actually calls for, 0-5): Python, LLM integration, RAG, evaluation/observability, cloud (AWS/GCP), TypeScript. Seniority: senior/staff practitioner — NOT junior, NOT frontier research-scientist. Languages: English (native). Geo: remote within the EU; cannot relocate. Comp: no hard floor.
